title: Cron auth fails closed off Vercel and the vitals endpoint is rate limited
detail: An unset CRON_SECRET outside production lets 40+ cron routes through; /api/vitals is an unauthenticated service-role insert with no per-IP limit. Also add a header presence gate (see headers-gate).

verify.note: Exits 0 only when the repair has landed; fails on main today.
